propositions: Single monolithic test iterates over 884 renderable units with ~1768 pandoc spawns, causing unbounded serial execution time (91.6s idle, 504.8s under CPU saturation) that exceeds the 300s per-test timeout on contended macOS runners
pytest-timeout with thread method calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the xdist worker process outright without a traceback when per-test budget is exceeded

Test failure is reproducible deterministically on macOS py3.13 cell by lowering the timeout budget, reproducing the identical 'node down: Not properly terminated' and worker crash shape observed in CI

The 14-minute gap between worker death and crash report reflects remaining session time from other workers, not kill latency, as the two log lines are emitted by different xdist components at different times

Fix chunks the test into fixed-size batches (40 units per chunk) via pytest.mark.parametrize, bounding per-test cost to ~4.2s idle and distributing work across xdist workers while preserving byte-identity comparison of all 884 units against the oracle
